name: MuseForge
description: Self-hosted AI studio for video, images, audio and audiobooks Generates video, images, audio, long-form text and complete audiobooks on your own GPU. Requires an NVIDIA card.
longDescription:
MuseForge generates video, images, audio, long-form text and complete audiobooks on your own hardware. Nothing is sent to a cloud service.

Beyond single generations there is a Director mode that plans a whole music video or short film from one sentence, a Storywriter for novel-length prose with translation and a continuity audit, and an audiobook producer that turns a document into spoken chapters with a voice per character. Everything the web interface can do is also a REST API, and a built-in MCP endpoint lets an AI agent drive it directly.

Hardware: an NVIDIA GPU with at least 6 GB of VRAM and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host. There is no AMD, Apple Silicon or CPU-only mode. Model weights are 50-300 GB depending on which models are used.
